subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving rates of change or accumulated area, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models a realistic scenario (velocity/position, cost/marginal cost) using a derivative or integral relationship
exercise.pictorial: Student graphs the scenario before interpreting the solution's real-world meaning
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world rate-of-change or accumulation word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot identify whether the problem calls for a derivative (rate) or integral (accumulation) approach

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
